name: abl-oeunit-test-explorer
description: Run and explore OpenEdge ABL unit tests using OEUnit

oeunit.testFilePattern.description: Glob pattern to find test files

oeunit.port.description: Port number for the OEUnit persistent server

oeunit.timeout.description: Socket timeout in seconds for client connections and server reads (default: 60)

oeunit.loglevel.description: Log level for OEUnit server (info=all messages, warning=warning+error, error=error only)

oeunit.workspaceFolder.description: Workspace folder path to use for OEUnit server (defaults to first workspace folder if not specified)

oeunit.autostart.description: Automatically start the OEUnit server when the extension activates

oeunit.environmentVariables.description: Environment variables to set when starting the Progress executable. These can override DLC and PROPATH if needed.

oeunit.multiProjectMode.markdownDescription: **[Experimental]** Enable multi-project workspace support. When enabled, the extension starts a dedicated OEUnit server per project (on separate ports) and maps test items to their owning project. Project discovery follows a three-tier priority: (1) explicit `oeunit.projectPaths` if configured, (2) workspace folders from the `.code-workspace` file, (3) single-folder root detection. Requires a window reload to take full effect.

oeunit.projectPaths.markdownDescription: Explicit list of project root folder paths for multi-project mode. When non-empty, **overrides automatic project discovery** — only these folders are used. Each entry must be the absolute path to a folder containing `openedge-project.json`. Use the **OEUnit: Add Project Folder…** command for a folder-picker dialog, or add/remove entries here directly.

oeunit.portBase.description: Base port used when multi-project mode allocates dedicated server ports

oeunit.portStep.description: Port increment applied between multi-project OEUnit servers

oeunit.projects.markdownDescription: Per-project setting overrides, keyed by the **absolute folder path** of each project (case-insensitive on Windows). The key must match a path in `oeunit.projectPaths` or an auto-detected workspace folder. Supported keys: `port`, `loglevel`, `autostart`, `timeout`, `exec`, `oeargs`, `environmentVariables`.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
